hooks.name: Security-Sensitive File Review
hooks.description: When auth, config, or dependency files are modified, review for security implications.

action.prompt:
A security-sensitive file was modified. Review for:

AUTH:
- AUTH_BYPASS should only be true in dev; ensure it's not accidentally hardcoded true.
- User ID must always come from the auth token dependency, never from request body.
- Firebase Auth token validation is not bypassed in production paths.

CONFIG:
- No secrets hardcoded (API keys, tokens, passwords). All via env vars.
- New settings have sensible, secure defaults.
- Firestore project ID is not committed with real values.

DEPENDENCIES:
- New packages are from well-known publishers with active maintenance.
- No overly broad version ranges (e.g., '*' or '>0.0.0').
- Check for known vulnerable patterns in the package name.

MOBILE:
- Auth emulator config is gated behind a build-time flag, not always active.
- Token storage doesn't leak to logs or telemetry.

Flag any concerns. Approve if changes are safe.
